_comment: TEST-PREP draft profiles. Default: scenario_intent (draft_truth_v3). Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md.

scenario_intent.description: Honest scenario drafts: one bundle per scenario_groups[] row; plain-English intent actions; requirement-linked results.
scenario_intent.actions_policy: Describe what must be achieved; variant_sequence = one step per check variant in group order.
scenario_intent.results_policy: Requirement keys (CRT-####) in results[]; formulas with formula_provenance when present.

crtqa_outline.description: LEGACY CRTQA-shaped executable outline (calibrate/benchmark only; no PRECON).
crtqa_outline.actions_policy: Expand case_outline rows when operator supplies plan in temp/
crtqa_outline.results_policy: Observable check per action; requirement keys only in results[].

teaching.description: Legacy TEST-PREP v2 teaching drafts (opt-in via draft_profile=teaching).
teaching.actions_policy: Up to illustration_budget worked sub-scenarios per check; remainder [TBD: …] per coverage.
teaching.results_policy: Teach checklist intent even when actions are mostly [TBD].

_min_case_count_note: scenario_intent uses scenario_groups combinatorics; min_case_count matrix applies to legacy crtqa_outline only.
